integrity: Proof and code are provided for reproducibility. The mathematical assessment is internal only; no independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Dimension-asymptotic theorem for a uniform random permutation and independent Dirichlet\((1,\ldots,1)\) input, with fixed \(0<\alpha<1\). The exact finite-size cycle-index identity concerns auxiliary unnormalized cycle averages, not the normalized maximum. Broader sampling models and endpoint mixing regimes are outside scope. Direct comparison with the complete 2024 Jamilov--Khudoyberdiev journal article remains unavailable.
title: A branching-process extreme-value law for random permutation quadratic population equilibria
